how_to_read: Fields beyond id/title/source: `buzz` = how many DISTINCT outlets carry the same story (corroboration). `seen` = the paper already ran this story on that date: pick it again ONLY if there is a genuinely new fact (a verdict, number, reversal), never for continued interest. `flags` = why a desk editor would be wary (press-release wording, company's own channel, roundup/opinion format, weak fit with the section): treat flagged items as guilty until the text proves a real event. `when` (opportunities) = the real deadline/event date. stories.title: Two killed, Indian among injured after Russian drone hits Turkish cargo ship
stories.extract:
Russian drone strike hits Turkish cargo ship in Black Sea, killing 2 (representative image)
NEW DELHI: At least two people were killed and several crew members, including an Indian national, were injured after a Russian drone strike caused a fire aboard a Turkish-owned civilian cargo vessel in the Black Sea.The Indian Embassy in Romania said three Indian nationals were among the crew of the vessel, identified as MV Royad Mammadov, and that one of them was injured and receiving medical attention.

stories.title: Set up 24-hour monitoring cells to prevent sexual offences, Supreme Court tells Delhi Police
stories.extract:
Underlining the need to take preventive measures against sexual offences, the Supreme Court on Monday (October 5, 2026) asked the Delhi Police to set up 24-hour monitoring cells for continuous surveillance of vulnerable areas. The court also asked the police to strengthen patrolling, particularly around educational institutions and public spaces.
